scope: Publish exact source/results bytes with bounded, reconstructible byte chunks.

fixed-polyhedron-ellipsoid-level1-v1.limitations: Every original physical center,3mm radius/profile/strength, friction, material/density and omega remains unchanged. All original physical probes, outside indices, complete corner fields, raw global peaks and original force budgets remain. New fields require a separately closed fresh auditor before physical interpretation; this producer alone does not establish a converged tail, native model comparison, resolved-contact or warmed accuracy/cost acceptance.

Three levels extend the original last mesh by two independently generated CAD/volume levels; these axes remain coupled. Both latest diagnostics are reported without replacing earlier six-level curves, omitted near-interface regions or unresolved geometry/volume/integration/native model/feedback/contact/application/cost requirements. Passing adjacent diagnostics alone is not continuum certification.

limitations: All20 new fine equilibria across the two geometry archives and ten original states retain unchanged3mm physical loads, materials, original probes and raw global maxima. Each geometry has15 fresh complete stiffness/mass/load/force/corner/quadrature/probe/energy audits. Seed polyhedral geometry stays fixed; volume/surface basis and boundary quadrature remain coupled. The unchanged generic auditor limitations mention a CAD family, but the hashed fixed-polyhedron mesh metadata and volume/area/COM qualifications define this actual family. No physical convergence, singularity or continuum accuracy/cost result is accepted. Files of at least50MB are preserved as exact ordered32MiB byte ranges, individually gzip-compressed, with original/part/stored SHA256 and offsets. Join decompressed ranges in index order to restore the original file exactly; no records are reduced or excluded. Runtime staging uses hard links for unchanged small originals.
